## Get paid without awkward emails
Daily 08:40 reads **Invoices** and sends exactly one email per stage:

| stage | when |
|---|---|
| pre_due | 3 days before |
| due | due date |
| overdue_7 | +7 days |
| overdue_14 | +14 days |
| final_30 | +30 days (you get alerted too) |

Deterministic templates (no AI on money). Mark `status` = `paid` to stop. Sends you a daily summary.
